messages.content: Compare lambda and T7 with blastp, only keep E-values up to 1e-5.

I set the **E-value** of the blastp node to `1e-5` and linked it to the report.

- BLAST keeps hits up to 10 by default, which lists weak matches.
- An empty result would mean no significant homologs, not a failure.

Ready to run when you are.
